How long does SEO take to work?

Ava Digital · Updated 2026 · ~4 min read
Short answer: Most businesses see measurable ranking movement in 3–6 months and meaningful traffic in 6–12 months. Local SEO often moves faster — 60–90 days — because the competition is more defined.

What “working” actually means

SEO has three stages: rankings move (weeks to months), traffic grows (months), and leads arrive (the goal). Watching only rankings makes it feel slow; watching leads keeps it honest.

Typical timelines

  • New website: 6–12 months to build trust and traction.
  • Established site: 3–6 months, since Google already trusts the domain.
  • Local SEO: 60–90 days for movement, 3–6 months for real gains.
  • Competitive national terms: 12+ months.

What speeds it up

Consistent content, a technically healthy site, existing domain authority, and a few quality local links all pull the timeline forward. There’s no legitimate shortcut to instant — anyone promising page one in days is selling risk.
